blocks.text: Hoanna ruin chests sometimes hold a {item:essentialcraft5:mystical_accessory} (about one per two chests, see [[hoanna/relics]]). Each one is random: a necklace, a belt or a ring with its own look, all decided the moment the chest is opened.

rows: depends on its shape: a necklace only fits a necklace slot, and so on (the tooltip says which)
0% to 10%; against MRU Corruption damage and matrix damage from MRU clusters
0% to 10%; less radiation builds up in Hoanna (see [[baubles/radiation]])

blocks.text: Resistances from several Mystical Accessories add up, but each kind counts at most <t>40%</t> in total (a necklace, a belt and two rings all at their best), no matter how many accessory slots you have. They also add up with armor (all four armor pieces together count as much as one accessory).
A Mystical Accessory taken from the Creative inventory has no shape yet; it gets one as soon as it is in your inventory.
